summary: Iteration 9 — User-Wise Pricing enhancement (variant-level Offers + best-value selection + upsell + case suggestion) tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 14/14 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_offers_upsell.py covering (a) Offers CRUD: GET /api/admin/pricing/offers/{vid} lists existing (10+3, 60+22, demo 10+5); POST creates free_qty and case_price offers with customer_type; DELETE removes; POST 400 on missing buy/free; (b) Best-offer = MAX free units: at qty=60 the engine returns 30 free via 10+5 (beats 60+22 which gives 22) with scheme_label='10+5'; at qty=22 returns 10 free via 10+5; qty=5 returns 0; (c) Category-scoped offers: guest at qty=20 gets public-only best (10 free via 10+5) ignoring a doctor-only 20+8; logged-in doctor at qty=20 with a doctor-scoped 10+9 gets 18 free (offer_source='category'); (d) Upsell: at qty=22 cart returns upsell {add:8, target_qty:30, free_qty:15, label:'10+5'}; at qty=30 no lower-add nudge; (e) Regression: guest cart price_source='public'; doctor (no customer-specific override) price_source='category' unit_price=170; product detail /api/products/{slug} exposes variant.active_schemes list. FRONTEND: Admin login OK; Pricing Manager > Category tab data-testids all wired: cat-product-picker + cat-product-picker-search + cat-offers-<variantId> button opens offers-dialog; dialog shows the 3 existing offers (10+5, 10+3, 60+22 as Public/All chips); Add Offer flow (offer-ct Doctor, offer-type free_qty, offer-buy=15, offer-free=4, offer-add) increased row count 3→4 (offer-row-<id>), offer-del-<id> reverted 4→3. Category rate matrix for NERVIPHOS-BM 100ml shows Doctor 170 / Agency 160 / Medical 140 / Distributor 90 / Farm 50 (multi-category rates confirmed). Cart upsell verified via doctor session on /cart: cart-upsell-<sku> shows 'Add 9 more to reach 10 and get 5 free (10+5)'. Sidebar 'Schemes & Offers' nav link removed. Direct /admin/schemes route intentionally still exists.

critical_code_review_comments: helpers.compute_scheme: correctly picks MAX free_units for free_qty offers. However, for special_price (case_price) it picks lowest special_price but only if best.scheme_id is None. If a free_qty offer is picked first AND a case_price with lower per-unit exists, the returned scheme_id stays on the free_qty and scheme_label is overwritten by the case row string — resulting mismatch (scheme_id → free_qty offer, scheme_label → '<min> @ ₹<sp>'). Consider making the tie-break explicit: compare effective per-unit price of both types.

pricing_engine.pick_offer_schemes: when a doctor-specific offer exists, PUBLIC/all offers are excluded entirely (never mixed). This matches the spec 'category > public, no stacking', but note that a customer in a category with only weak category offers can miss a stronger public offer. Confirmed intentional per problem statement.

pricing_engine.compute_upsell: only considers free_qty schemes — does not nudge users toward a case_price tier when it's cheaper per unit. That's covered by the separate case_suggestion object, so fine, but consider unifying the two upsell paths.

routers/pricing.create_offer: allows arbitrary customer_type strings; no validation against CATEGORIES list. A typo (e.g. 'doctors') would silently never match. Consider validating customer_type in {'all', *CATEGORIES}.
routers/pricing.delete_offer: returns {deleted: true} even if id doesn't exist. Consider 404 for unknown id.
AdminPricingManager footnote still links to 'Schemes & Offers' route even though the nav link was removed — copy inconsistency.

success_rate.frontend: core flows verified: offers CRUD in dialog, sidebar cleanup, cart upsell for doctor. Product-detail upsell UI selector not exercised (qty stepper); backend upsell contract verified.
